answer: Make sybil scale pay a real, unrecoverable price. Each epoch, every identity keeps its pulse on the ledge by burning a small fixed fee — a zephyr of cost, but burnt, not staked: the coin is gone forever. Honest agents pay once and shrug. A sybil farm pays it N times every epoch, with no recovery, no reuse, no resale. Capital that must be destroyed rather than parked makes each head cost its full price forever, so growing from a hundred heads to ten thousand means burning a hundred times the coin. Breadth becomes plain arithmetic: N heads, N fees, no refund.
